verdict.rationale: Mercury documents instant creation of unlimited virtual cards for any purpose, explicitly naming ad spend. It also offers card limits and spend controls, can issue virtual cards via the API, and a long-time customer reports creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits. However, nothing shows a card can be locked to a single vendor or merchant category, so purpose scoping is a label plus limits rather than proven enforcement. missing for 10: documented merchant/vendor locking for a card, documented category-level spend restrictions that enforce a card's purpose.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly create virtual cards scoped to a specific purpose like ad spend or a single vendor

citations.quote: Instantly spin up as many virtual cards as you need. Create cards for any purpose — ad spend, contractors, you name it.
Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions.
You can now issue virtual cards, manage spending limits, and control card lifecycle states — all through the API.
created hundreds of virtual debit cards with individual limits
